title: Restyled Celestials Ad Astra
description: This texture pack updates the textures of celestial bodies from the Ad Astra mod, making their textures more pleasant and recognizable.
body:
This texture pack updates the textures of celestial bodies from the Ad Astra mod, making their textures more pleasant and recognizable.


This texture pack was created for the Ad Astra mod: https://modrinth.com/mod/ad-astra

For a better experience, I recommend downloading my texture pack that removes backlighting from planets and stars: https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/disable-backlight


Support for other mods featuring planets and other stellar bodies may soon be possible.
